newsitem.title: USA: Belden establishes $200 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Belden establishes $200 mln credit facility.

text.p: Belden Inc, a manufacturer of cable and cord products for electronic markeets, said it established a new five-year $200 million multicurrency revolving credit facility.
The facility replaces a $150 million revolving credit facility that was not due to expire until August 1999.
The new credit facility provides a lower interest rate spread over LIBOR and lower fees than the one it replaced.
"We anticipate using the new facility to finance acquisitions and for general corporate purposes," said chief financial officer Richard Reece in a statement.
The new agreement is between Belden Wire & Cable Co and eight banks.
